name: The Shopping List (d66)
description:
For each item, roll a d6 for its kind and a d6 for the item itself; roll again on a repeated item. Only the kind matters to the rules: it decides which Castle Duty gets its edge there.

Rulebook, Chapter 8: The Shopping List.

Read the total as the two dice, tens then units: 34 is a 3 for the kind and a 4 for the item. On the Raid HUD, Shopping list → Roll the list rolls a whole list on this table (a repeat is rolled again) and keeps it on the HUD.
